one_liner: Code hosting, pull requests, issues, Actions CI and package registry.
auth_notes: Fine-grained or classic PAT, OAuth app, or GitHub App (JWT to installation token). Bearer header on all REST calls.
credential_path: Free account, Settings > Developer settings > PAT; GitHub App or OAuth app registration is also self-serve.
breadth_note: Hundreds of REST endpoints plus full GraphQL v4 covering repos, issues, PRs, Actions, orgs, security.

mcp.note: Official local server plus GA remote endpoint api.githubcopilot.com/mcp with OAuth.

notes: Reference-grade developer API. GitHub App installation tokens are the right pattern for multi-tenant toolkits.

one_liner: Frontend hosting platform for deployments, projects, domains and edge functions.
auth_notes: Access token in Authorization: Bearer header; OAuth2 available for marketplace integrations acting on user teams.
credential_path: Free Hobby account, then Account Settings > Tokens > Create Token; scope to a team if needed.
breadth_note: Deployments, projects, env vars, domains, DNS, teams, logs, edge config, firewall and analytics.

mcp.note: Official hosted remote server at mcp.vercel.com with OAuth; shipped public beta then expanded.

notes: Team-scoped tokens matter: most endpoints need a teamId query param for org resources. Exact per-endpoint limits unconfirmed.

one_liner: Jamstack hosting for sites, deploys, forms, functions and DNS.
auth_notes: Personal access token as Authorization: Bearer; OAuth2 required for public multi-user integrations.
credential_path: Free account, then Applications > Personal access tokens > New access token.
breadth_note: OpenAPI-described: sites, deploys, builds, forms, submissions, DNS zones, env vars, teams, hooks.

mcp.note: Official server; docs at docs.netlify.com/build/build-with-ai/netlify-mcp-server and a hosted remote endpoint.

rate_limits: 500 requests/minute for most endpoints; stricter on some operations
notes: Deploy-creation endpoints have tighter limits than the 500/min default. OAuth app registration is self-serve for public integrations.

one_liner: CDN, DNS, WAF, Workers, R2 and Zero Trust edge platform.
auth_notes: Scoped API tokens via Authorization: Bearer (preferred); legacy global API key with X-Auth-Email/X-Auth-Key. OAuth used by MCP servers.
credential_path: Free account, then My Profile > API Tokens > Create Token with scoped account/zone permissions.
breadth_note: Very large surface: zones, DNS, WAF, Workers, KV, R2, D1, Pages, Access; GraphQL analytics separately.

mcp.note: Catalog of managed remote servers (*.mcp.cloudflare.com) with OAuth; repos cloudflare/mcp and mcp-server-cloudflare.

rate_limits: 1,200 requests per 5 minutes per user, account-wide cumulative
notes: 1,200/5min limit is cumulative across dashboard and all tokens, so it bites in agent loops. Notification webhooks not directly reconfirmed.

one_liner: Hosted Postgres with auth, storage, realtime and edge functions.
auth_notes: Management API uses personal access token (Bearer) or OAuth2; per-project data APIs use anon/service_role keys and user JWTs.
credential_path: Free account, then Account Settings > Access Tokens; scoped PATs in public alpha, classic PATs are full-access.
breadth_note: Management API for projects, orgs, branches, secrets, functions; per-project PostgREST plus pg_graphql and realtime.

mcp.note: Hosted server at mcp.supabase.com/mcp with OAuth dynamic client registration; PAT fallback for CI. Repo github.com/supabase/mcp.

rate_limits: Management API 60 requests/minute per user, scoped per project/org
notes: Two distinct API layers: control plane (Management API, PAT) and data plane (project URL + anon/service keys). Model both.

one_liner: Graph database; Cypher over Bolt/HTTP plus an Aura cloud management API.
auth_notes: Aura API: OAuth2 client_credentials to api.neo4j.io/oauth/token. Database Query API: HTTP Basic with DB username/password.
credential_path: Aura console > API credentials, but Free/Professional users must add billing info or marketplace project first.
breadth_note: Aura REST is instance/tenant lifecycle CRUD only; real work is Cypher over Bolt or the HTTP Query API.

mcp.note: Official server (get-schema, read-cypher, write-cypher, list-gds-procedures) using NEO4J_MCP_URI/USERNAME/PASSWORD; also neo4j-contrib/mcp-neo4j Labs servers.

blocker: Not a SaaS REST app: needs DB connection credentials; Aura API credentials gated behind billing info on free tiers.
notes: Two separate things: open-source/self-hosted DB (Bolt or Query API /db/{name}/query/v2, Basic auth) vs Aura management REST API (OAuth2).

one_liner: Cloud data warehouse with SQL REST API and Cortex AI services.
auth_notes: Key-pair JWT (RS256, ~1hr, X-Snowflake-Authorization-Token-Type: KEYPAIR_JWT) or Snowflake OAuth; PATs also supported.
credential_path: 30-day trial with $400 credits, no card at signup.snowflake.com; then generate RSA key pair and set user RSA_PUBLIC_KEY.
breadth_note: SQL API at /api/v2/statements plus object REST APIs for warehouses, databases, tasks, users, Cortex.

mcp.note: Snowflake-managed MCP server GA Nov 2025, OAuth + RBAC; plus Snowflake-Labs/mcp open-source server.

blocker: Account-scoped URL, key-pair setup and warehouse/role config make onboarding heavier than a plain API key.
notes: Every call needs the account identifier host. Outbound webhook notification integrations exist but are not classic event webhooks; unconfirmed detail.

one_liner: Managed MongoDB clusters with a versioned Administration API.
auth_notes: Service accounts via OAuth2 client_credentials at /api/oauth/token (1hr bearer) — recommended; legacy API keys use HTTP Digest auth.
credential_path: Free M0 cluster account, then Organization Access Manager > Applications > Service Accounts (or legacy API keys).
breadth_note: Admin API v2 covers clusters, projects, orgs, users, backups, alerts, metrics, network access, billing.

mcp.note: Official MongoDB MCP Server, local (mongodb-js/mongodb-mcp-server) and Atlas-managed hosted variants.

notes: HTTP Digest (not Basic) for legacy keys — many HTTP clients need explicit digest support. Atlas Data API and App Services reached EOL Sep 30 2025.

one_liner: Observability platform for metrics, logs, traces, monitors and dashboards.
auth_notes: DD-API-KEY header for writes; reads additionally need DD-APPLICATION-KEY. OAuth2 for marketplace integrations and MCP.
credential_path: Account (free plan or 14-day trial), then Organization Settings > API Keys and Application Keys.
breadth_note: v1 and v2 REST across metrics, logs, events, monitors, dashboards, incidents, SLOs, users, RUM, security.

mcp.note: Official remote server at mcp.datadoghq.com (site-specific), OAuth2 or API+app keys; in Preview. Repo datadog-labs/mcp-server.

rate_limits: Per-endpoint; 250k events/min org limit; log intake not rate limited
notes: Two-key model (API + app key) is the main integration gotcha. Auth docs state no plan gating for API access, but per-plan limits unconfirmed.

one_liner: Error monitoring and performance tracing for application issues and releases.
auth_notes: Organization auth tokens (recommended) or personal tokens in Authorization: Bearer; internal/public integrations support OAuth-style installs.
credential_path: Free sentry.io account, then Settings > Developer Settings > Organization Tokens, or User Settings > Personal Tokens.
breadth_note: Projects, issues, events, releases, teams, orgs, alerts, discover queries, source maps, Seer.

mcp.note: Official first-party remote server at mcp.sentry.dev/mcp, OAuth-only on the hosted endpoint; self-host with a token.

notes: Rate limits are enforced per caller identity, so minting extra tokens will not raise throughput. Numeric limits not published.
